cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government digital-skills programme for the public is in service and counted; the Cidadão Digital counts are those of EMIS, an interbank company, with no government body named.
cells.note: Presidential orders of August and October 2026 authorised World Bank-financed digital-skills programmes, not yet counted. The only counts, over 600,000 by December 2024, are for EMIS's Cidadão Digital project, which no source ties to a government body, so not stage 3.
